eventNaming: Logical evidence labels below are proposed reporting adapter concepts. They do not introduce operational states or prove that runtime ingestion exists.
admissionGates: required evidence exists and is complete for stated scope
approved privacy policy for any sensitive or identifiable breakdown

defaults.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.
defaults.comparison: Same definition, units, scope and compatible source coverage; ratios use percentage points. No growth percentage when prior count is zero.
defaults.privacy: No raw personal intake. Customer-based measures require approved merchant-scoped pseudonymous identity and suppression policy. Health is administration only.
defaults.freshness: Reporting owner must supply policy reference and measured coverage intervals; no invented freshness threshold.
defaults.drilldown: Server-resolved exact contributing evidence under renewed authorization; preserve period/date basis/model/timezone/definition version.

metrics.question: How many requests entered each actual workflow?
metrics.aggregation: Distinct request IDs, grouped by model; never infer people or fulfilled quantity.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Which work records reached their actual domain completion?
metrics.aggregation: Distinct work IDs with valid completion evidence. Later refunds/disputes remain separate states.
exclusions: no merging appointments with product units
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: How long did the first valid merchant response take?
metrics.aggregation: Median and distribution of elapsed durations; show eligible, responded, open and missing-event counts. No response inferred from unrelated updates.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: What recorded reasons explain cancellations?
metrics.aggregation: Count eligible cancelled identities by recorded reason with Unknown separate; report denominator by model.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: How did actual offering variants perform?
metrics.aggregation: Group compatible actual offering/model/unit outcomes. Missing variant remains Unknown. Do not rewrite history from current catalogue.
metrics.drilldown: Offering and exact matching accepted work
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: How many product orders were fulfilled?
metrics.aggregation: Distinct orders with the owner-defined fulfilled outcome; partial fulfilment shown separately.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Which item units were fulfilled?
metrics.aggregation: Sum confirmed fulfilled quantities within compatible unit groups; ordered quantity is separate.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Were orders ready by the accepted promise?
metrics.aggregation: Eligible orders with ready<=promise divided by eligible orders with both instants; show missing promises and open cases separately.
metrics.dateBasis: accepted promise due in period, closed observation
exclusions: delivery punctuality is a separate measure
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: What happened to scheduled appointments?
metrics.aggregation: Mutually exclusive appointment outcomes as of cutoff; cancellations, no-shows, completed and open remain distinct.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Which requests became confirmed appointments?
metrics.aggregation: Distinct confirmed request identities / eligible request identities from the same cohort; pending stays visible.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: How much usable provider time was reserved?
metrics.aggregation: Union of reserved intervals clipped to report scope / usable resource-time intervals; avoid duplicates across offerings.
exclusions: travel capacity only if explicitly modeled
no schedule denominator inferred from bookings
metrics.drilldown: Availability intervals, provider schedule and exclusions
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Did visits arrive within the accepted arrival window?
metrics.aggregation: Eligible arrivals within the accepted arrival window / eligible due visits with complete observation; open/missing events separate. Visit completion timing requires a separately recorded commitment.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: How much usable asset time was reserved?
metrics.aggregation: Union of reserved intervals per asset clipped to report period / union of usable intervals. Synthetic example 1240/2000=62%.
metrics.drilldown: Included reservation intervals, resource capacity and excluded intervals
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: How much usable asset time was actually used?
metrics.aggregation: Union of verified actual-use intervals per asset / union of usable asset intervals; missing returns require owner-defined open-interval treatment.
metrics.drilldown: Usage intervals and handover/return evidence
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Were rental returns recorded by the accepted due time?
metrics.aggregation: Due rentals with recorded return<=due / eligible due rentals with closed observation; show overdue open and missing evidence separately.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Were transfers recorded at the promised milestone?
metrics.aggregation: Eligible transfer milestone events meeting promise / eligible transfers with complete observation; waiting and greeting scope remain explicit.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: How many usable session places were reserved?
metrics.aggregation: Confirmed allocated places / usable places for each occurrence; deduplicate shared pools across ticket tiers.
metrics.drilldown: Dated occurrences, capacity pools and allocations
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: How many booked places have recorded attendance?
metrics.aggregation: Recorded attended places / eligible booked places with closed attendance observation; unrecorded remains Unknown.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: How much usable space capacity was reserved?
metrics.aggregation: Union of allocated compatible space intervals / usable space intervals, time-weighted when capacity is quantitative. Space-hours, tables and seats remain separate.
exclusions: no space-hour inference from guest counts
metrics.drilldown: Space intervals, reservations and exclusions
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Which confirmed departures actually operated?
metrics.aggregation: Distinct confirmed departures by actual operated/cancelled/open outcome; show parties and places separately.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Were accepted production jobs completed by their agreed due time?
metrics.aggregation: Eligible due jobs with accepted completion<=due / eligible due jobs with closed observation; partial output and agreed due revisions remain visible.
exclusions: accepted quote is not production acceptance
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Which requests reached an accepted quote?
metrics.aggregation: Distinct eligible request identities with an accepted quote / eligible request identities. Do not divide decision-period acceptances by another request cohort. Separate open and enquiry-only routes.
exclusions: quote-only does not imply fulfilled work
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Were collection and return promises both met?
metrics.aggregation: Eligible closed cycles meeting both accepted windows / eligible cycles with complete observation; separately show collection-only and return-only performance.
exclusions: do not label partial custody as complete
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Which accepted jobs completed or remain blocked?
metrics.aggregation: Distinct accepted jobs by source-confirmed outcome as of cutoff; stage durations use actual events only.
metrics.dateBasis: job accepted or completed, explicitly selected
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Which rights were issued or enrolled?
metrics.aggregation: Distinct issued entitlements; active-at-date is a separate interval measure. Recurring authorization not inferred.
metrics.dateBasis: issue event or explicit valid-at date
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: How were valid rights redeemed?
metrics.aggregation: Distinct confirmed redemption events and typed consumed quantities; distinct passes shown separately; reversed redemptions separate.
exclusions: a pass sale is not attendance
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Did accepted shipments meet the selected milestone promise?
metrics.aggregation: Eligible due shipments with recorded milestone within promise / all eligible due shipments in the closed observation window, including Unknown outcomes in the denominator. Open, late and unknown outcomes remain separate.
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: How much usable storage capacity was occupied?
requiredEvidence: storage unit and compatible capacity unit
metrics.aggregation: Integral of confirmed occupied compatible quantity over time / integral of usable compatible capacity over time; reservation is separate from actual custody.
exclusions: no addition of incompatible storage units
metrics.drilldown: Custody quantity intervals, capacity and exclusions
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: What permitted customer activity repeated?
metrics.aggregation: Repeat completed work and unique returning identities are separate measures under approved policy; no claim of globally unique people.
metrics.unit: repeat records or approved identities separately
metrics.drilldown: Matching Work records and their recorded events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: What feedback was published?
metrics.aggregation: Count ratings by approved scale/subject; separate reply workload. Keyword themes labelled as tags, not validated sentiment.
exclusions: private/rejected reviews excluded according to owner
metrics.drilldown: Authorized published reviews
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: What promotion delivery was measured?
metrics.aggregation: Count qualified impression events under source-defined deduplication; not unique people.
metrics.drilldown: Qualified campaign delivery events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: What measured promotion taps occurred?
metrics.aggregation: Count qualified tap events; tap/impression ratio is an event ratio with compatible delivery coverage.
metrics.drilldown: Qualified campaign tap events
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: Which accepted orders met the attribution rule?
metrics.aggregation: Distinct eligible accepted order IDs assigned once under approved model. Concept fixture 36 orders/600 taps=6%; configurable 30-minute tap window. Correlation is not incremental lift.
exclusions: value/ROAS unavailable until value and refund pipeline approved
metrics.drilldown: Attribution assignments and separately authorized matching Work
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: What merchant credits were posted?
metrics.aggregation: Sum confirmed merchant credits in one currency on posting basis; synthetic 480000 KES.
exclusions: never use guest-paid envelope as merchant sales
metrics.drilldown: Exact approved Money postings with independent finance authorization
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: What refund debits were posted?
metrics.aggregation: Sum confirmed refund debits in one currency on posting basis; synthetic 12000 KES. Do not infer from current order stage.
exclusions: never use guest-paid envelope as merchant sales
metrics.drilldown: Exact approved Money postings with independent finance authorization
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: What recorded fee debits were posted?
metrics.aggregation: Sum source-confirmed fee debits in one currency; synthetic 23400 KES, not a fee policy.
exclusions: never use guest-paid envelope as merchant sales
metrics.drilldown: Exact approved Money postings with independent finance authorization
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.

metrics.question: What was the net posted merchant activity?
metrics.aggregation: For the fixture only: 480000 credits -12000 refund debits -23400 fee debits =444600 KES. Real source must include all approved posting classes and reconcile to Money; not payout or profit.
exclusions: never use guest-paid envelope as merchant sales
metrics.drilldown: Exact approved Money postings with independent finance authorization
metrics.availability: Candidate only; source adapter, definition and permissions must pass admission gates.
